Felix Kowalski
felix.kowalski@example.com | Providence, RI
Felix Kowalski has 16 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Principal Backend Engineer at Sable Solutions (2024-2026), where
they introduced Terraform-managed infrastructure, cutting provisioning time by
46%. Before that, Staff Backend Engineer at Palodex Dynamics (2021-2024).
Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at Cinder Digital (2010-2021). Education:
M.S. Electrical Engineering, SMU, 2010; B.S. Electrical Engineering, SMU, 2008.
Core skills: System design, PostgreSQL, Distributed systems, TypeScript,
RabbitMQ, AWS, GraphQL, Node.js, Terraform.
